name: How long does it take to paint a house exterior?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior painting project depends on the size of the house, weather conditions, the amount of preparation required, and the size of the painting crew. A typical single-family home might take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. Larger or more complex homes, or those requiring extensive repairs, could take longer. Good communication with your contractor about the timeline is important.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior house painting usually takes 3 to 7 days for a typical home, varying by size, preparation, and weather.
